native_generation_prompt:
Edit only the right-side testing and archive objects, the single orange arrow and the bottom caveat. Replace both progress-bar shapes with two distinct solid nonnumeric test fixtures, one orange hexagonal stress-test object and one indigo red-team input object, with no meter, strip, score, or progress symbol. Route the single orange arrow from the bottom physical edge of the testing fixture, down the open right-side channel, into the top of the physical archive object. Move Planned weights slightly to the right of that route if necessary; the arrow may never touch its letters or the dashed boundary. Raise the detached caveat letters so their bottom is above y=574. Preserve hosted sampling and fine-tuning bench and preserve the white separation from weights.

Create one premium factual textbook editorial mechanism as a single raster PNG. Pure white backdrop, crisp vector-like rendering, subtle editorial depth, an uncluttered hierarchy, and high-contrast indigo and mineral orange. Target exact 1200×630. Use an imaginary central 40:21 artwork area if the native canvas is taller, with blank bleed only outside that area. The exported 40:21 area must use its width and height, without letterboxing.

Hosted sampling and fine-tuning are available now; downloadable weights are a separate planned step after safety testing.

Show hosted evaluation as an open cutaway workbench on the left. Unmarked input, sample, tune and result forms suggest separate hosted actions. The right column shows external safety testing, red-team trial forms and a future archive object in a dashed outline. Use a clear white separation between the hosted bench and future archive. Only the conditional right-column arrow may have an arrowhead. Do not imply any approval or availability of weights.

Use at least twelve meaningful forms with a distinct internal hierarchy. Print only these exact phrases, exactly once each: "Hosted access", "Run inference", "Fine-tune", "Safety testing", "Planned weights", "Weights still pending". Bold sans serif. Priority typography at least 36px, other labels at least 28px on the 1200×630 export. Keep all labels inside 40px safe margins, outside connectors, and inside the reserved boxes. Do not print instructions, region IDs, positions or metadata.

Only these arrows, with arrowheads attached to actual object ports rather than label text: Safety testing → Planned weights. The announced weights release is planned after external testing and red-teaming. No connector from hosted sampling or tuning to a downloadable archive.

No people, humanoids, avatars, shields, gears, knobs, dashboards, logos, invented interfaces or controls, realistic photos, scenery, fake writing, decorative microstrokes, charts, unsupported numbers, success badges, permission changes or alternate implied flows.
